operation_details.item: The user does not want SEO keywords, search-optimized headings, or meta descriptions in marketing copy drafts.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What kind of marketing copy are you working on today?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I’m revising a product page and want the writing to feel distinctive rather than formulaic.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I can help shape the voice, structure the argument, and sharpen the calls to action while keeping the language natural.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I also want to avoid the usual search-focused treatment when you draft marketing materials for me. I do not want SEO keywords, headings optimized for search, or meta descriptions in any marketing copy I ask you to draft.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Understood. I’ll focus on persuasive, audience-aware copy without adding SEO keywords, search-optimized headings, or meta descriptions.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Good. The copy should still be clear, but it shouldn’t sound like it was written to satisfy a checklist.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. I’ll prioritize a strong point of view, specific benefits, and a smooth reading experience over formulaic optimization.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Please keep that approach in mind when I bring you future landing-page assignments.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I will. Send over the product, audience, and any essential details when you’re ready, and I’ll draft the page in that style.
